prompt: A pipeline needs Node 22, which is not the image’s default. What is the dependable approach?
explanation: Explicit setup steps — like `actions/setup-node` with the exact version — make the toolchain part of the workflow’s own definition instead of an accident of the image. Preinstalled software is a convenience, never a contract.

options.text: Assume the image updates soon and pin nothing
Set it up explicitly in the job with the setup action, versioned
Bake a custom Docker image per workflow
Ask developers to install Node manually before pushing
